sentences.en: After the funeral, Tom went to Huck.
He said: Huck, the gold is in the cave.
Huck said: how do you know?

sentences.ar: قال توم: رقم اتنين، تحت الصليب.
sentences.en: Tom said: Number Two, under the cross.

sentences.ar: بالمغارة، بالممر اللي شفت فيه جو الهندي، في صليب مرسوم بالدخان عالصخر.
sentences.en: In the cave, in the passage where I saw Injun Joe, there is a cross drawn in smoke on the rock.
I saw it, and did not understand it then.
Huck said: but the door is locked.
Tom said: not the crack.
No one knows the crack but me.

sentences.ar: أخدوا شمع وأكياس وطعام، ومركب زغير، ونزلوا عالنهر.
sentences.en: They took candles and sacks and food, and a small boat, and went down the river.

sentences.ar: وطلعوا من الشق، وزحفوا لجوا، ووصلوا للممر، وللصليب.
sentences.en: And they went in through the crack, crawled inside, reached the passage, and the cross.
And under it a big rock.
They dug around it, and found a hollow.
And in the hollow, the box.

sentences.ar: وفتحوه، وعدوا الذهب على ضو الشمع.
sentences.en: And they opened it, and counted the gold by candlelight.
Twelve thousand dollars.

sentences.ar: أكتر مما شافته القرية كلها بحياتها.
sentences.en: More than the whole village had seen in its life.

sentences.ar: طلعوا الذهب بالأكياس، وحملوه للمركب، ورجعوا القرية بالليل.
sentences.en: They carried the gold out in the sacks, took it to the boat, and returned to the village at night.

sentences.ar: وبالطريق، مسكهم الويلزي، وقال: تعالوا، الأرملة عاملة حفلة.
sentences.en: And on the way, the Welshman caught them, and said: come, the widow is giving a party.

sentences.ar: وبالحفلة، الأرملة قالت قدام الكل: هَك فِن أنقذ حياتي.
sentences.en: And at the party, the widow said before everyone: Huck Finn saved my life.
Because the Welshman had told in the end.

sentences.ar: وقالت: وأنا رح آخده يعيش عندي، وأعلمه، وأدخله الكنيسة.
sentences.en: And she said: and I will take him to live with me, and educate him, and bring him to church.

sentences.ar: وهَك صار وجهه أحمر، وحس إن الحياة انتهت.
sentences.en: And Huck's face went red, and he felt life had ended.
And Tom said: Huck is not poor!
Huck is rich!

sentences.ar: وضحك الكل، وتوم طلع، ورجع بالأكياس، وكبها عالطاولة.
sentences.en: And everyone laughed, and Tom went out, came back with the sacks, and poured them on the table.

sentences.ar: وصار الذهب بالبنك، نص لتوم ونص لهَك.
sentences.en: And the gold went into the bank, half for Tom and half for Huck.

sentences.ar: والقاضي تاتشر قال إنه توم رح يصير محامي أو جنرال.
sentences.en: And Judge Thatcher said Tom would become a lawyer or a general.

sentences.ar: وهَك عاش عند الأرملة تلات أسابيع.
sentences.en: And Huck lived at the widow's for three weeks.

sentences.ar: تياب نضيفة، وشوكة وسكينة، وسرير، وكنيسة.
sentences.en: Clean clothes, a knife and fork, a bed, and church.
And then he vanished.

sentences.ar: وتوم لقاه بعد تلات أيام، ببرميله القديم.
sentences.en: And Tom found him three days later, in his old barrel.
In his old clothes, with his pipe.

sentences.ar: قال هَك: يا توم، الغنى مش لي.
sentences.en: Huck said: Tom, riches are not for me.
I cannot breathe in houses.

sentences.ar: قال توم: هَك، إذا ما رجعت للأرملة، في مشكلة.
sentences.en: Tom said: Huck, if you do not go back to the widow, there is a problem.
I cannot take you into my new gang.
The gang is all respectable people.
And Huck thought a long time, and said: fine.
I go back.
But for a month.
And so ends the story of Tom Sawyer.

sentences.ar: لأنه قصة ولد، ولما بيكبر الولد، بتصير قصة تانية.
sentences.en: Because it is a boy's story, and when the boy grows up, it becomes another story.
